economy.summary: Supported House-passed legislation in June 2026 to eliminate the gross receipts tax on electricity, which makes up about 6 percent of an electric bill, saying the bill puts money back in the user's pocket and calling it a common-sense measure that helps constituents financially.
economy.short: Supported eliminating electricity gross receipts tax to lower electric bills.

taxes.summary: Voted against the 2024-25 state budget, saying he made a commitment to be fiscally prudent with taxpayer dollars and that its $2.7 billion spending increase would drain state reserves and bring about tax increases in later years. Called the budget unsustainable.
taxes.short: Voted against 2024-25 budget, citing spending levels and future tax increases.

abortion.summary: Voted yes in July 2022 on Senate Bill 106, a joint resolution proposing a state constitutional amendment stating there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or other right relating to abortion. The measure passed the House 107-92.
abortion.short: Voted for constitutional amendment stating no state right to abortion.

education.summary: Endorsed the education funding in the 2026-27 state budget, saying it would adequately fund public schools while preserving the Educational Improvement Tax Credit and Opportunity Scholarship Tax Credit programs, which he said give families flexibility in choosing a course of learning.
education.short: Supports 2026-27 school funding and the EITC and OSTC scholarship programs.

healthcare.summary: Supported Act 2 of 2022, which directed $210 million to hospitals and behavioral health facilities for recruitment and retention of nurses and other front-line employees, and highlighted its creation of a task force on the opioid epidemic's effects on children.
healthcare.short: Supported $210 million for nurse recruitment and retention at hospitals.

energy.summary: Voted in December 2021 for a concurrent resolution disapproving the regulation that would have Pennsylvania join the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, a multi-state cap-and-trade program covering carbon emissions from power plants. The resolution passed the House 130-70.
energy.short: Voted to disapprove regulation joining Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative.

guns.summary: Voted in May 2023 against House Bill 1018, which would have created extreme risk protection orders allowing courts to temporarily remove firearms from a person found to present a risk. In November 2021 he voted for Senate Bill 565, which would have allowed concealed carry of firearms without a license.
guns.short: Voted against extreme risk protection orders; voted for permitless concealed carry.
